supersedes.disposition: Preserved immutable historical evidence; this successor corrects formal-closeout consumption without mutating it.

acceptance_separation.publication_order_basis: The candidate is bound to its committed Git object. This additive acceptance and successor manifest have no fabricated publication commit or timestamp; their Git publication order is established only when a later commit records them.

disclosures: All disclosures in the exact candidate, all three accepted batch manifests, and the exact acceptance artifact remain binding on every consumer.
This formal-closeout manifest does not claim browser behavior, completion, persistence, XP, idempotency, API correctness, production behavior, or asset-loading success.
The candidate's immutable-history and historical-test supersession disclosures remain intact; no legacy artifact is rewritten, backdated, or relabelled green.

requirements: Bind the exact hashes of this manifest, the candidate, the acceptance, the three batch manifests, and the current closeout gate.
Preserve every bound disclosure and revocation rule without narrowing or omission.
Treat any bound-file hash drift, revoked batch, or failed current or successor gate as non-consumable.

revocation.on_hash_drift_or_gate_failure: non-consumable; regenerate additively and obtain fresh acceptance
revocation.legacy_artifacts: never rewritten by this successor manifest
